data.official_name: Legge 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 — Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale
data.description: First national comprehensive AI statute enacted by an EU Member State complementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act). Establishes sectoral transparency, human-in-the-loop oversight, minor data protection rules, national governance (AgID and ACN), and criminal offences for unlawful AI deepfakes.
data.notes: Status: In force October 10, 2025 (approved by the Senate September 17, 2025; published in Gazzetta Ufficiale No. 223 on September 25, 2025; verified as of 2026-11-03). Mandates clear disclosure and human decision-making authority when AI systems (including conversational assistants) are deployed in healthcare, employment, intellectual professions, public administration, and the judiciary; requires verifiable parental consent for minors under 14 accessing AI services processing personal data; and introduces Article 612-quater of the Penal Code (1 to 5 years imprisonment for harmful non-consensual AI-manipulated content).
